The Company also announces its Net Asset Value per ordinary share before Indian CGT deferred tax provision as at 9 October 2026 was estimated to be 205.19 pence (Ex Dividend of 1.9 pence). The Net Asset Value per ordinary share has been estimated based upon 64,108,124 ordinary shares with voting rights in the Company as at 9 October 2026. This estimated daily NAV is provided by the Investment Manager of the Company and is, by its nature, based on incomplete and estimated data. The making of such an estimate involves known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors which may cause the estimated results, performance, or achievements to be different from any actual results, performance, or achievements.
